messages:
Sophia: Quick FYI — I'm going to roll a small runtime batching tweak at 21:00 UTC (~2h). Low-risk, no API/schema changes. Affects token batching thresholds only.

Sophia: Plan: canary 5% for 30m, monitor latency/error rate, then promote to 100% if green. Rollback = revert batch-config and scale batch size down.

Sophia: Command I'll run: ```./deploy.sh --image registry.redwood/rt:batch-tweak-202603 --canary=5% --batch-config=low-latency.json```

oncall-bot: :bell: Reminder: add rollout watchers (react :eyes: to claim).

Jamal: I'm oncall tonight — I can watch 21:00–01:00 UTC. Ping me if CPU >75% or error rate >0.5%.

Maria: Any user-facing endpoints affected? Do we need CS notification?

Sophia: No external contract changes. Only internal inference batching behavior. CS FYI optional — I'll notify if we see client-facing errors.

Leo: I'll run the canary job and tail logs. LMK when you’ve pushed the image.

Sophia: Pushed image `registry.redwood/rt:batch-tweak-202603` to prod registry. Starting canary in ~5m.

oncall-bot: Deployment started (canary 5%) — automated task created.

Jamal: Can confirm canary pods come up: 5 pods healthy. Initial metric snapshot: small-req p50 +2ms, p95 +8ms. No obvious errors in logs.

Maria: Thanks — adding @support for awareness.

Sophia: If error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m -> rollback. Jamal, please execute rollback: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n prod --to-revision=previous```

Leo: Copy. I'll keep `kubectl logs -f deploy/runtime -n prod --since=10m | grep -i warn` running and post anything noisy.

Jamal: Created a temp alert in Alertmanager: `runtime_batch_error_rate > 0.5% for 10m` -> notify #eng-oncall and pager.

Sophia: Nice — thanks all. Will post a short update after 30m canary.

oncall-bot: Canary check-in: 30m passed, metrics within expected bounds. Promoting to 100%.

Leo: Promoted to 100% now. Watching autoscale and latency dashboards.

Jamal: Observing stable CPU and no error surge. Will keep monitoring until 01:00 UTC.

Maria: Marking this as FYI for release notes.

oncall-bot: Rollout complete at 1934012600 — no rollback triggered. :white_check_mark:
